decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list for actual backpacks, excluding accessories like chairs and stoves. My consideration set includes a mix of slings (TUDEQU), tactical packs (G4Free), lightweight daypacks (ZOMAKE), and larger internal frame hiking packs (Granite Gear, Mardingtop). I decided to purchase the ZOMAKE Ultra Lightweight 20L backpack. It has an exceptional number of reviews (nearly 15,000) with a high 4.6 rating, and at under $15, it represents excellent value for a packable daypack that is well-suited for travel and day trips. The high social proof and low price point made it the most attractive option among the set.
